description:

Beginner to Novice

###Activity details

Experience two of San Francisco’s most iconic adventures with this 2-day Alcatraz and citywide e-bike tour package. 

On your selected booking date, head to Pier 33 to board the ferry to Alcatraz Island, where you’ll explore the former federal penitentiary with the award-winning audio tour. Wander through historic cell blocks, learn about infamous inmates like Al Capone, and take in panoramic views of the Bay before returning to the city.

The following day, meet your guide for a 15-mile electric bike tour through San Francisco’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Ride an energy-saving e-bike that makes hills easy as you explore North Beach, cruise along the waterfront to the Ferry Building, and pass Oracle Park and the Design District. Stop for a break at a local food-truck park before continuing into La Mission to admire colorful murals and rich cultural history.

Pedal through the iconic Castro District, home to Harvey Milk Plaza, and continue through the Wiggle into the legendary Haight-Ashbury area, birthplace of the Summer of Love. Finish the tour with a ride down Polk Street, an ever-evolving neighborhood layered with history, before returning to Fisherman’s Wharf. Guests may keep their e-bike until closing time or return it after the tour.


***Alcatraz Info***
Alcatraz departure time will be sent approximately 4 days before your tour. 

The ferry depart from Pier 33. Arrive a minimum of 30 minutes before your departure. All riders’ names must have been submitted with booking. Riders MUST present ID at tour time.

***Bike Tour Info***
Check-in 30 minutes before the tour and meet your guide at ***2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER*** in Fisherman’s Wharf.

faq_items.question: What time does the Alcatraz tour leave from Pier 33?
faq_items.answer: Alcatraz departure times (if not shown on the calendar) will be provided approximately 4 days before departure. Guests must provide their legal first and last names at the time of booking.

faq_items.question: What language is the audio tour provided in?
faq_items.answer: Thee Alcatraz audio tour is available in 11 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese, and Russian.

faq_items.question: Is the ferry ticket included to Alcatraz?
faq_items.answer: Yes, the round-trip ferry ride to and from Alcatraz Island is included in this package.

faq_items.question: What time does the bike tour leave?
faq_items.answer:
The tour departs daily at 11:00 AM year-round. We ask that all guests arrive at least 30 minutes early to complete paperwork and be fitted for their bikes. The tour is approximately 15 miles and lasts 3–4 hours, with a refreshment break along the way.

The tour departs from our Fisherman’s Wharf Tour Center, located at 2661 Taylor Street.

faq_items.question: Where does the tour go?
faq_items.answer:
Our Streets of San Francisco Tour is a 15-mile, full-city electric bike tour that covers many of San Francisco’s unique neighborhoods. The tour starts in Fisherman’s Wharf and rides through North Beach (San Francisco’s Little Italy). From there, it winds past Chinatown into the Financial District, showcasing its high-rise buildings and upscale boutique stores.

The route then continues to the Ferry Building and along the San Francisco waterfront toward the Bay Bridge, looping behind Oracle Park, a world-class urban baseball stadium located right on the bay.

Along the way, you’ll also see Rincon Hill, Chase Center, the Design District, the culturally rich Mission and Castro Districts, the murals of Clarion Alley, Lower Haight and Haight-Ashbury, Alamo Square overlooking the Painted Ladies, NOPA, City Hall, the San Francisco Opera House, Polk Gulch (San Francisco’s original LGBTQ+ neighborhood), and Aquatic Park.

faq_items.question: Are the Electric bike and helmet included with this tour?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we provide pedal-assist electric bikes that can travel 25+ miles depending on usage. Helmets are included and required for the tour, which takes place on city streets and bike lanes throughout San Francisco. After the guided tour, you’re welcome to continue using the bikes for a complimentary bonus rental as long as the battery lasts.

faq_items.question: Is this tour suitable for children?
faq_items.answer: This tour is for riders ages 13 and older. Exceptions may be made for slightly younger children who are skilled, meet the height requirements, and have a signed parental consent form.

faq_items.question: How many people on the tour?
faq_items.answer: It depends on the season, day of the week, and the tour, but our Streets of SF tours tend to be smaller more intimate groupings.

faq_items.question: Is Bay City Bike open daily?
faq_items.answer: We are open 365 days a year, rain or shine. We suggest booking your tour ahead of time though, as spots can fill up quick. We also offer a 20% discount if you book online!
